description: This file defines the 'Reward' class within the Opencart platform, responsible for managing reward points calculations, application, and removal during the order process. It contains methods for getting total rewards, confirming reward applications on orders, and undoing rewards (unconfirm).

classes.name: Reward
classes.description: A class that manages reward point calculations and updates during the checkout process in an OpenCart environment.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and applies reward point discounts to the order totals, adjusting taxes and total amount accordingly.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Confirms the reward points used in an order, deducting them from the customer's reward balance.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes reward points associated with an order, typically called if an order is canceled or modified.
